name: chronos-geraldo-netto
description: Development tooling for the Chronos Calendar Cinnamon applet: the test suites, the coverage gate and the linters. The applet itself ships from files/.
author: Geraldo Netto <geraldonetto@gmail.com> (https://github.com/geraldo-netto)

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: if python3 -c 'import pyflakes' 2>/dev/null; then python3 -m pyflakes files/chronos@geraldo-netto test; else echo 'pyflakes not installed; skipping python lint'; fi
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
